field_text_formatted.value: The other four are kept on the Nuxt server between requests. Drupal's Cache-Control decides how long, ttl can only shorten it, and when in doubt nothing is kept. The README has the full rules. Across a 24-page crawl, that is 144 index and menu requests down to none once the first page has been rendered.
